programs.title: A Micro-universe Ep.4
programs.desc: A fascinating experiment in microphotography, revealing the tiny creatures living right under our noses. Over the course of a month, a typical northern Chinese family discovers the hidden mysteries of the microscopic world in all too specific detail.

programs.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.1
programs.desc: Follow Foodwise hosts Tianran and Hannah as they visit Xishuangbanna, the home of Pu’er tea. While there, they’ll explore night markets, taste the local Dai and Hani specialties, and celebrate the Dai New Year in style. From fishing, encountering elephants and hiking to ancient tea gardens, experience all that Xishuangbanna has to offer.

programs.title: Secrets of the Flaming Mountains Ep.1
programs.desc: In 908, a Central Asian expedition to the Flaming Mountains in Xinjiang, China, made a startling discovery—mummified remains buried in the Astana Cemetery, unlocking a mystery over a thousand years old. Meanwhile, a revered Buddhist monk and a Central Asian king forged a life-and-death bond—one of the most extraordinary friendships in Buddhist history. But what really happened? And what would eventually lead to the fall of the once-thriving Gaochang Kingdom.

programs.title: The Ingenious Crafts II Ep.1
programs.desc: Through a detailed look at more than a dozen intangible cultural heritage crafts from southern Fujian, including stone carving, puppet head carving, kiln ceramics, and bead embroidery, this episode traces the continuity of traditional craftsmanship through macro and aerial photography.
